scenarios.description: record_interest and hangup in one response (#262): the batch is judged in greet and the hangup moves the call to finish, whose line is said as written. The simulator runs only the flow; that the caller hears the line itself is held by internal/aicall.

scenarios.name: caller answers all three questions

expect.announce: Thank you for your time. A product advisor will reach out shortly with an exclusive trial offer, so please expect a call. Goodbye.
